```{r, echo = TRUE}
# ============================================================================
# Data Simulation
# ============================================================================

simulate_longitudinal_data_realistic <- function(n_persons = 180,
                                                 n_therapists = 20,
                                                 sd_therapist = 3,
                                                 mean_neg = 2,          # avg. negative events/week
                                                 mean_pos = 3,          # avg. positive events/week
                                                 sd_log_rate = 0.4,     # between-person variability
                                                 beta_neg_within  =  0.5,
                                                 beta_pos_within  = -0.3,
                                                 beta_neg_between =  1.0,
                                                 beta_pos_between = -0.5,
                                                 seed = 123) {
  set.seed(seed)

  # Balanced groups
  groups <- rep(1:3, length.out = n_persons)
  groups <- sample(groups)

  # Therapists nested in conditions (7 / 7 / 6), balanced caseloads
  therapist_condition <- rep(1:3, length.out = n_therapists)
  therapist_of_person <- integer(n_persons)
  for (g in 1:3) {
    idx     <- which(groups == g)
    ids     <- which(therapist_condition == g)
    ids_rep <- rep(ids, length.out = length(idx))
    therapist_of_person[idx] <- ids_rep[sample.int(length(ids_rep))]
  }

  # Therapist random intercepts
  therapist_intercepts <- rnorm(n_therapists, mean = 0, sd = sd_therapist)
  
  # Correlation matrix 
  correlation_matrix <- matrix(c(
    1.0, 0.5,-0.3,-0.3,-0.3,-0.3, 0.3,
    0.5, 1.0,-0.3,-0.3,-0.3,-0.3, 0.3,
   -0.3,-0.3, 1.0, 0.1, 0.1, 0.1,-0.3,
   -0.3,-0.3, 0.1, 1.0, 0.1, 0.1,-0.3,
   -0.3,-0.3, 0.1, 0.1, 1.0, 0.1,-0.3,
   -0.3,-0.3, 0.1, 0.1, 0.1, 1.0,-0.3,
    0.3, 0.3,-0.3,-0.3,-0.3,-0.3, 1.0
  ), nrow = 7, byrow = TRUE)
  
  var_names <- c("CQ_D", "CEQ", "PTQ", "SEK27", "BEAQ", "IIPD", "SF12")
  rownames(correlation_matrix) <- var_names
  colnames(correlation_matrix) <- var_names
  
  eigenvals <- eigen(correlation_matrix)$values
  if (any(eigenvals <= 0.001)) {
    correlation_matrix <- Matrix::nearPD(correlation_matrix, corr = TRUE)$mat
    correlation_matrix <- as.matrix(correlation_matrix)}
  
# Group effects based on Cohen’s d
  # Assumptions:
  # - SD of changes (pooled within-group) ≈ 10 points
  # - 9 time points (0–8), average change over the entire period
  # - d = 0.80 for Group 1 → Total change = 0.80 * 10 = 8 points over 8 time points
  # - d = 0.50 for Groups 2 & 3 → Total change = 0.50 * 10 = 5 points over 8 time points
  
  # Slope = Total change / Number of time units
  group_slope_effects <- c(
    "1" = -8.0 / 8,   # d = 0.80: -1.00 points per timepoint
    "2" = -5.0 / 8,   # d = 0.50: -0.625 points per timepoint
    "3" = -5.0 / 8    # d = 0.50: -0.625 points per timepoint
  )
  
  # Random effects
  # SD for random intercept 
  sd_intercept <- 10.0
  # SD for random slope
  sd_slope <- 0.25
  # corrrelation between intercept and slope
  cor_int_slope <- -0.2
  # covariance matrix
  cov_int_slope <- cor_int_slope * sd_intercept * sd_slope
  random_effects_vcov <- matrix(c(
    sd_intercept^2, cov_int_slope,
    cov_int_slope, sd_slope^2), nrow = 2)
  
  # Residual variance
  residual_sd <- 5.0
  
  # Baseline values
  baseline_corr_data <- MASS::mvrnorm(
    n = n_persons, 
    mu = rep(0, length(var_names)), 
    Sigma = correlation_matrix)
  
  # Random effects for every single person
  random_effects <- MASS::mvrnorm(
    n = n_persons,
    mu = c(0, 0),
    Sigma = random_effects_vcov)
   
  # Person-specific weekly event rates
  neg_rate <- exp(log(mean_neg) + rnorm(n_persons, 0, sd_log_rate))
  pos_rate <- exp(log(mean_pos) + rnorm(n_persons, 0, sd_log_rate))
  
  timepoints <- c("After_PECAN", "T1", "T2", "T3", "T4", "T5", "T6", "T7", "T8")
  dataset <- data.frame()
  
  for (person_id in 1:n_persons) {
    person_row <- data.frame(Person_ID = person_id)
    person_row$group <- groups[person_id]
    person_group <- as.character(groups[person_id])
    
    # Baseline PTQ (0-60 scale)
    baseline_z <- baseline_corr_data[person_id, "PTQ"]
    baseline_ptq <- 30 + 10 * baseline_z  # Mean ~30, SD ~10
    
    # Person-specific random effects
    person_intercept <- random_effects[person_id, 1]
    person_slope <- random_effects[person_id, 2]
        # Therapist
    person_row$therapist_ID <- therapist_of_person[person_id]
    therapist_intercept <- therapist_intercepts[therapist_of_person[person_id]]
    
    # Group-specific Slope effects
    group_slope <- group_slope_effects[[person_group]]
    
    # PTQ values over time
    for (i in seq_along(timepoints)) {
      timepoint <- timepoints[i]
      time_value <- i - 1  # 0 to 8
      
      # Analysis
      # Weekly event counts
      neg_events <- rpois(1, neg_rate[person_id])
      pos_events <- rpois(1, pos_rate[person_id])

      expected_value <- baseline_ptq + person_intercept + therapist_intercept +
                       (group_slope + person_slope) * time_value +
                       beta_neg_within  * (neg_events - neg_rate[person_id]) +
                       beta_pos_within  * (pos_events - pos_rate[person_id]) +
                       beta_neg_between * (neg_rate[person_id] - mean_neg) +
                       beta_pos_between * (pos_rate[person_id] - mean_pos)
      
      # Residual error 
      residual_error <- rnorm(1, mean = 0, sd = residual_sd)
      final_value <- expected_value + residual_error
      
      # Define scale (0-60)
      final_value <- round(pmax(0, pmin(60, final_value)))
      
      person_row[[paste0("PTQ_", timepoint)]] <- final_value
      person_row[[paste0("NEG_", timepoint)]] <- neg_events
      person_row[[paste0("POS_", timepoint)]] <- pos_events
    }

    dataset <- rbind(dataset, person_row)}
  
  return(dataset)}


# ============================================================================
# Preprare data and fit model
# ============================================================================

prepare_long_format <- function(dataset) {
  timepoints <- c("After_PECAN", "T1", "T2", "T3", "T4", "T5", "T6", "T7", "T8")

  long_data <- dataset %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols = dplyr::matches("^(PTQ|NEG|POS)_"),
      names_to = c(".value", "timepoint"),
      names_pattern = "^(PTQ|NEG|POS)_(.*)$") %>%
    dplyr::rename(PTQ_value = PTQ,
                  negative_events = NEG,
                  positive_events = POS) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      timepoint_numeric = match(timepoint, timepoints) - 1,
      group = factor(group),
      therapist_ID = factor(therapist_ID)) %>%
    # Person-mean centering (within-person part)
    dplyr::group_by(Person_ID) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      neg_pm = mean(negative_events, na.rm = TRUE),
      pos_pm = mean(positive_events, na.rm = TRUE),
      neg_cw = negative_events - neg_pm,
      pos_cw = positive_events - pos_pm) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    # Grand-mean centered person means (between-person part)
    dplyr::mutate(
      neg_pm_c = neg_pm - mean(neg_pm),
      pos_pm_c = pos_pm - mean(pos_pm))

  # Treatment coding: interaction terms are pairwise comparisons against
  # group 1 (group2 = group 2 vs. 1, group3 = group 3 vs. 1).
  # NOTE: with contr.sum(3) the terms are deviations from the grand mean
  # instead, which are NOT the contrasts the hypothesis refers to.
  contrasts(long_data$group) <- contr.treatment(3)

  return(long_data)}

fit_lmer_model <- function(long_data) {
  tryCatch({
    model <- lme4::lmer(
                  PTQ_value ~ group * timepoint_numeric +
        neg_cw + pos_cw + neg_pm_c + pos_pm_c +
        (1 + timepoint_numeric | Person_ID) + (1 | therapist_ID),
      data = long_data,
      control = lme4::lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", 
                                    optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)))
    return(model)
  }, error = function(e) {
    return(NULL)})}

empty_result <- function() {
  data.frame(
    term = c("group2:timepoint_numeric", "group3:timepoint_numeric"),
    estimate = NA, se = NA, t_value = NA, p_value = NA,
    significant = NA, singular = NA)}

extract_interaction_effects <- function(model) {
  if (is.null(model)) return(empty_result())

  coef_summary <- summary(model)$coefficients
  interaction_rows <- grep("group.*:timepoint_numeric", rownames(coef_summary))

  if (length(interaction_rows) == 0) return(empty_result())
  
  interaction_coefs <- coef_summary[interaction_rows, , drop = FALSE]
  p_values <- 2 * (1 - pnorm(abs(interaction_coefs[, "t value"])))
  
  results <- data.frame(
    term = rownames(interaction_coefs),
    estimate = interaction_coefs[, "Estimate"],
    se = interaction_coefs[, "Std. Error"],
    t_value = interaction_coefs[, "t value"],
    p_value = p_values,
    significant = p_values < 0.05,
    singular = lme4::isSingular(model))

  rownames(results) <- NULL
  return(results)}


# ============================================================================
# Power Analysis
# ============================================================================

run_power_analysis <- function(sample_sizes = c(80, 120, 160, 200),
                               n_simulations = 100,
                               n_therapists = 20,
                               sd_therapist = 3) {
  power_results <- list()
  
  for (n in sample_sizes) {
    cat("Running power analysis for n =", n, "\n")
    sample_results <- list()
    
    for (sim in 1:n_simulations) {
      if (sim %% 20 == 0) cat("  Simulation", sim, "/", n_simulations, "\n")
      
            sim_data <- simulate_longitudinal_data_realistic(
        n_persons = n, n_therapists = n_therapists,
        sd_therapist = sd_therapist, seed = 1000 * n + sim)
      long_data <- prepare_long_format(sim_data)
      model <- fit_lmer_model(long_data)
      interaction_results <- extract_interaction_effects(model)
      interaction_results$repetition <- sim
      interaction_results$sample_size <- n
      
      sample_results[[sim]] <- interaction_results}
    
    if (length(sample_results) > 0) {
      power_results[[as.character(n)]] <- do.call(rbind, sample_results)}}
  
  final_results <- do.call(rbind, power_results)
  rownames(final_results) <- NULL
  return(final_results)}

calculate_power <- function(power_results) {
  power_summary <- power_results %>%
    dplyr::group_by(sample_size, term) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      power = mean(significant, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_estimate = mean(estimate, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_se = mean(se, na.rm = TRUE),
      convergence_rate = sum(!is.na(p_value)) / dplyr::n(),
      singular_rate = mean(singular, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  return(power_summary)}
```

```{r, results = 'hide', message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
# ============================================================================
# Calculate Power
# ============================================================================

results_file <- "power_results_RQ1.rds"

if (file.exists(results_file)) {
  results <- readRDS(results_file)
  cat("Load existing results:", results_file, "\n")
} else {
  results <- run_power_analysis(
    sample_sizes = seq(160, 340, by = 10),
    n_simulations = 1000)
  saveRDS(results, results_file)}

power_summary <- calculate_power(results)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# Show Results
# ============================================================================

print(power_summary, n = Inf, width = Inf)

ggplot(power_summary, aes(x = sample_size, y = power, color = term)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.80, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  labs(title = "Power-Curve for Research Question 1",
       x = "Sample Size (n)",
       y = "Power (1 - β)",
       color = "Interaction") +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.1))
```
